card.name: Prepositions in machine-translated German-style English
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, in, during, under, if and both in awkward, machine-translated English text, often from German sources on genetics, history or materials news.

modes.label: Prepositions in translated prose
modes.description: A preposition like of, in, during or under appears where the phrasing reads like literal translation.
modes.example: Table<< of>> contents the mendelschen the laws

modes.label: Fixed phrases with odd wording
modes.description: A word inside a set phrase in stilted text, such as best care or feel free.
modes.example: performed with<< best>> care and attention

modes.label: Clause openers in genetics text
modes.description: A conjunction or quantifier starting a clause in translated Mendel-law text.
modes.example: (uniformity law and/or.Reciprocity) <<if>> two individuals of a kind
